description: Use of outbuilding as self contained 1 bed unit (retrospective)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The proposed new dwelling, by reason of
its poor design, size, scale, proportions and siting would appear contrived,
cramped and out of keeping with the wider pattern of development to the
detriment of the character and appearance of the streetscene, and the pattern
of development within the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary
to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of The London Plan (2021), Policies GR1
and GR10 of Harrow Local Plan 2021 – 2041 and adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Supplementary Planning Document: Garden
Land (2013)<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">Insufficient
information has been provided to </span>demonstrate that waste and refuse and
cycle parking can be provided within the curtilage of the site to meet the
Council’s requirements, contrary to Policies GR1, GR10, CE1 and M2 of the
Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the Residential Design Guide Supplementary
Planning Document (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph"><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The
proposed dwelling, by reason of its constrained site characteristics, layout
and proximity to the main dwelling, would result in a substandard form of
accommodation for future occupiers, and detrimental impact on privacy, noise
and air quality for neighbouring residents. As a result, the proposal would
fail to provide an acceptable living environment for all and would be contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of the
London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041) and the
adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).&nbsp;</span><o:p></o:p></p>
